answer: Start with Finger-vein plus fingerprint dual capture. The idea is simple: two vein maps that must match one hand, and that bridge alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. What makes this stick is that two vein maps that must match one hand cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the jetty of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the voyage for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
